dataset.description: Fifteen synthetic English support tickets authored for this portfolio evaluation before model inference; not real customer data or an independently annotated benchmark.
dataset.annotation_policy: Assign only the specific issue category. Reserve Technical Issue for application malfunction, not every login or connectivity issue. Use Account Management for requested account/profile changes, Login Problem for authentication, Billing for charges/refunds, Connectivity for connection failures. Labels are project-defined and not uniquely authoritative.

limitations: Synthetic English diagnostic set with project-authored labels; no independent annotation, real tickets, training or prompt tuning. Existing few-shot examples use overlapping labels, which differ from the specific-category evaluation policy. This protocol mismatch is preserved and must be considered when interpreting mode differences. Timing is one sequential CPU run after warm-up, not a deployment benchmark.
